title: Bullet Hit FX
description: Peter-approved splash remake (2026-10-15). Feel-booth preview only — not wired into live combat. fx-hit-fire and fx-hit-water are 4×24 @ 8 fps (0.5s, 125ms per frame), once, origin (0.5, 0.5) at the impact point. Same motion as the splash strip (burst → droplets → fade); fire is the recolor. Sheets are 96×24 horizontal strips with transparent alpha. Scale 1 (24px is bullet-adjacent). Blend ADD or NORMAL; the feel booth uses ADD. Feel-booth key 8 is fire and key 9 is water. fx-hit-electric is not in this wave.
